visuals.depicts: The 2026-11-02 client and execution topology: a Windows control VM issues commands over SSH; curl and the streaming probe run on node 0. Nemotron uses a local multiprocess executor with TP8+EP8. Inkling and Muse use Ray, TP8 within each of two PP stages. Each node has a local NVMe model cache. RCCL traffic is host-staged with NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL=0.
visuals.incremental_value: Combines the recorded client placement, per-model executor and two-node communication path; the official Azure VM icon identifies the hosting resource, not the custom scripts.
visuals.does_not_prove: The drawing is not runtime evidence; correctness and performance require the bound logs and requests.

source_class_decisions.reason: The 2026-11-02 MI300X run is shown as result tables and raw request/response/log files in data/mi300x-run/ rather than as charts: with 2-3 smoke requests per model there is no distribution to plot, and a chart would overstate the measurement.
The original NVFP4 Figure 2 directly explains value and scale storage.
No paper figure was used to establish per-checkpoint component settings; those claims use actual export configuration and named deployment recipes.
Customer conversations and the private request spreadsheet are not public visual assets.
